name: Time Slips
description: An anomalous experience in which a percipient apparently perceives, or briefly enters, a different time period (most often the past) before returning to the present without the passage of normal time.

aliases.name: Retrocognition
aliases.meaning: Apparent perception of a past event

origin: Reported worldwide; the largest published clusters are in the United Kingdom (Versailles in France, Liverpool, Wiltshire, Norfolk) and the United States.
